title: Adjunctive Pentoxifylline Enhances Clinical Remission and Reduces Inflammatory Biomarkers in Mild-to-Moderate Ulcerative Colitis: A Randomized Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Pilot Trial
comparison_or_design: The primary pentoxifylline add-on comparison in mesalamine-treated ulcerative colitis.
observations_or_assays: Clinical remission under the source-defined PMS rule
time_scope: Baseline to week 24, primary ITT analysis.
excluded: Per-protocol, mesalamine-exposure subgroups, clinical-response categories and other visits
Inflammatory biomarkers and exploratory regression models
population_or_material: The primary intention-to-treat population with mild-to-moderate UC.
requested_items: ITT Tables 2/4: baseline/week-24 PMS/IBDQ-32 medians, explicitly reported percentage changes and tests; remission counts/proportions/test. Include labeled adjusted P supplement. Exclude PP, clinical-response endpoint and medication-naive/experienced subgroup analyses.
